proposals.rationale: Soft hypothesis: omitting the argon-environment step may expose the catalyst/base system to air or moisture, potentially reducing reactive-species integrity.
Soft hypothesis: shortening the 80 °C stirred hold from the reported 12 h to the existing 2 min duration may leave insufficient time for conversion.
Soft hypothesis: eliminating stirring during the heated hold may introduce mass-transfer or concentration-gradient limitations.
Soft hypothesis: deleting the reactor-to-heater connection represents loss of the reported heating setup and may prevent maintenance of the intended reaction temperature.
Soft hypothesis: removing the sealed-pressure operational context represents loss of capped containment, potentially affecting inert containment and solvent retention during heating.
